dataList.content:
<This room...>
<这里是……>
dataList.place:
WARP Train Economy Class Cabin
WARP列车 经济舱 车厢

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
What... is with that look on thy faces?
为什么……大家都面带那样的表情？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Thou standest in the audience of the Prince. Where are thy smiles?
既然是前来觐见王子，就应竭尽全力露出最好的微笑才对。

He... must be the Bloodfiend who caused this outbreak. He is our target.
此人……应该就是这一切的罪魁祸首，也是我们此行要处理的血魔。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Fall to thy knees and grovel before royalty!
跪下，俯首，注意礼节！

... Who the hell are you to make those demands?
……你当自己谁啊？凭什么要我们做那种事？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I shall impart this upon thee only once, so listen well.
我只说一次，你们听清楚了。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Thou mayest address me as Prince Cassetti, Sixth Kindred in refuge from his Family, and the rightful prince who shall reign over thee!
我名为卡塞蒂，乃是逃离家族的六代眷属，君临于尔等之上的真正王子！

Art thou the villain... who hath brought such destruction and massacre upon this vessel?
此次列车之上发生的所有杀戮……皆是因汝而起吗？

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Thou art a chatty one, so rudely before your Prince. Yet, this welcome satiation has put me in quite the generous mood.
于王子面前询问如此多的问题实属无礼。但此刻我正好深感餍足，便放过你们一次吧。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
As thou must have seen on thy journey here... this place is a hall of banquet for a feast most majestic.
如你们所见，这辆列车是为举行盛大宴会所设的宴会厅。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
No matter how many Bloodbags I create, no matter how many of them I devour... humans just won't stop coming! I am only enjoying what cast themselves into my maw!
无论我如何制作血袋以供食用……人们都会不断地来到此地！我只需每次都尽情享受晚宴罢了！

... He dons a mask for the purpose of merrymaking.
……他戴着娱乐用的面具。

If we're really going to exchange pleasantries, why don't you take that mask off? Or are you unfamiliar with the basic etiquette?
如果真要接受对方的问候，露出全部面庞难道不是基本的礼仪吗？

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Oh, this... this mask!
这……这副面具！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Won't come off. Can't take it off. Shouldn't take it off! There's no Prince without the mask!
取不下来。无法取下。不能取下！那样就无法成为王子了！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
We're so, so ugly behind the mask; so we all decided to hide how repulsive we've become. But once I've drunk your blood full, then it'll all go back to how it used to be. Only then can I unmask myself...
面具后的我们姿态是如此丑陋，因此我们都将自己的面容隐藏起来。但只要我将你们的血全部吸干，一切就会恢复原样。只有这样，我才能揭下我的面具……

Who stitched that mask to your face? Not a half-bad job.
是谁把面具缝在你这家伙脸上的？手艺真不错。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Of course it's excellent! Ha ha! Because this mask was crafted by none other than the great and the eminent Barber, whose name I dare not even speak! But... but it hurts so much...!
当然了，哈哈！这面具可是那位提到名字都要满怀敬畏的理发师大人亲手为我制作的！但是……但是真的很痛啊……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
No, no! I'm smiling! Look, look how hard I'm smiling and laughing! HAHAHA! HA! HAAA... YES, I AM THE PRINCE, THAT'S WHAT I AM!
不！我在笑啊！你看我笑得多开心啊！哈哈哈！哈！哈……我可是王子啊！

He's a bloody loon, innit?
已经完全疯掉了啊。

All right, done with the giggles, then? Get ready for the beating of your life.
笑够了吗？够了的话现在该我狠狠揍你几下了。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
I... I enjoy things like you and your friends.
我……我喜欢你们这样的人。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Don't cry, bawling and bowing and sniveling on the ground for your lives...
是和那些哭着！喊着！趴在地上祈求我的饶恕的人不同的……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Lunge at me instead, hm?! The aggression, the boiling blood, oh, how I love the heat!
会主动扑向我的？热血沸腾的！那种人！

What are you, daft? Look around. There are thirteen of us and only one of you.
看看周围吧。就剩你一个人了。你真觉得能赢我们吗？

Do not let your guard down, Heathcliff. This entity has managed to turn countless passengers of this train into his Bloodbags.
希斯克利夫先生，请不要放松警惕。对手是将列车上的大部分乘客变成血袋的人。

I ain't letting my guard down. But... we blasted through so many Bloodbags we couldn't even keep count, didn't we?
我可没放松警惕……不过，从后面车厢开始，我们都是把见得到的血袋都打爆了才走的吧。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Couldn't even keep count...? Oh no, no... but the count is so important! I have to keep count of our visitors! Oh yes, of course! I do remember to keep count of our dearest visitors! Yessir, I do!
数字……是的，数字很重要。有多少来访者很重要！我记住了！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
You have no idea how powerful I am. And I shall not relinquish the throne of this budding kingdom to thee!
我很强大，非常强大。在这新王国前，我无意退让分毫！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
All I have to do is sit here and do nothing, and the Bloodbags present themselves before me! There's no paradise like this out there... you have no idea what I did to create this place!
只要坐在这个王座上，血袋们就会被送过来。你觉得别处还会有这样的乐园吗？你们明白我是怎样造就这个地方的吗！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Ohh, how elated my forebears would be, were they here to witness my creation! This cornucopia of abundance... this pleasure... oh, this freedom...!
啊啊，若亲族们能够见到此景将会多么欣喜，这份丰饶……这份快乐……这份自由……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
But this kingdom is mine! I made it! I'm not giving it away, nope!
但是这里是我的王国！我不会把它交给任何人！

This is rather curious.
我有些困惑。

It appears that this Bloodfiend leaves this car only on rare occasions...
虽然只是推测，但那位血魔看上去几乎没有离开过这节车厢……

... Yet we have seen signs of his insidious influence throughout every car we have visited so far.
也许他的影响力强大到不止能够波及到所有车厢的程度……

Then what he meant by how "the Bloodbags present themselves" before him has to be...
只要坐在这里血袋就会被送过来是在说……

dataList.title:
MultiCrack Office
多裂纹事务所
dataList.content:
HOLD ON A MINUTE!
等等！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
GYAH!!!
咦！！！

Someone suddenly and frantically charged into this car.
手忙脚乱地跑来我们所在车厢的是……

It was Sasha, the Fixer we ran into in one of the earlier cars.
在前面的车厢里遇见过的收尾人，萨莎。

Cassetti shrinks into his throne at this sudden intrusion, terror apparent in his face.
突然闯入的萨莎吓得卡塞蒂弯下了腰，蜷缩在他的王座上。

Ah, it is thee! By the— Hast thou truly journeyed here to assist us in our quest?!
汝难道！是为助吾等一臂之力才赶来的吗！

Lo! That villain is the Bloodfiend responsible for the tragedies that have transpired aboard this train!
看那边！那位血魔便是此一切之罪魁祸首！

Help us slay that cur and eventually lead the passengers thou hast protected thus far out of this train!
只要将其击倒，汝所保护之乘客便可全部从列车中安全逃离！

Bloodfiends...
血魔……

... What if there was more than a single Bloodfiend on board, one still capable of rational thought...?
如果这里还存在着……不是血袋也能保持理智的血魔的话……

dataList.title:
MultiCrack Office
多裂纹事务所
dataList.content:
Damn, you actually made it all the way back here? I guess the Wings don't give out contracts to just anyone.
哇啊……居然都到这里来了？接下翼的委托的收尾人果然不同凡响啊？

dataList.title:
MultiCrack Office
多裂纹事务所
dataList.content:
I... I used to fight to my damnedest, too. 'Till I was the last one standing...
我……我也曾拼尽全力战斗到最后了。直到剩下我一个人……

What's she talking about?
你在说什么呢？

dataList.title:
MultiCrack Office
多裂纹事务所
dataList.content:
But where did that leave me? Alone, three of my four arms ripped from my body.
最后，这四只手臂里，有三只被硬生生拔掉了。

dataList.title:
MultiCrack Office
多裂纹事务所
dataList.content:
Kinda funny how the perspective on life can just completely flip when you're really, really in the shit. I think my last thoughts were...
但是，很奇怪啊。我都只剩一只手了。

dataList.title:
MultiCrack Office
多裂纹事务所
dataList.content:
"Man... I... don't wanna die..."
却还是想着，啊啊……我还不想死啊……什么的……

dataList.title:
MultiCrack Office
多裂纹事务所
dataList.content:
So I fell on my knees and pleaded. I told him that...
所以我求饶了。只要能让我活下去……

Don Quixote, watch out!
快躲开，堂吉诃德！

dataList.title:
MultiCrack Office
多裂纹事务所
dataList.content:
... I'd do anything to live!
无论什么我都愿意做！

Blood rapidly crystallized around Sasha like a suit of armor as she swung her greatsword at the Sinners, striking them even before Faust's hurried shout had fully died away.
浮士德慌乱的叫喊声还没结束，萨莎的全身就已经遍布红色的晶体，挥起她的大剑向罪人们砍了下去。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Wha...
我……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
... What did I say?! I commanded you to give me a warning before jumping in like that!
我说过的吧！不要没有预告地突然冲出来！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Don't you know how loud your stupid arms are? I thought the Family had come for me!
也说过很多次了，你不知道这该死的手臂有多吵吗！让我以为是家人来找我了！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
I'm sorry, Lord Cassetti.
非常抱歉。卡塞蒂大人。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Ah... allow me to introduce my Kindred to thee, first of mine since the escape, for the kingdom I intend to build.
啊……介绍一下。这位就是我到外面来之后，为了王国的未来所制造的第一名眷属……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
My Kindred, my loyal squire... who shall be at my side as I build a dynasty of my own, my Family...
与我一同筑起我的王国……我的家族的，忠实的仆人……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Lord Cassetti, I had intended to select the more powerful of the bunch to send to this car as you have commanded me, but... the humans in my car were all weaklings. So I present before you this group from the first class car.
如您所言，选拔出强大的人并送至此处……但是我等所处的车厢内的人类，品质实在太过低劣……因而将头等舱的人们送来卡塞蒂大人面前。

Kindred...
眷属……

Are you even aware of the exact nature of a "Kindred?"
你，能明白眷属到底是什么吗？

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Nah, but I can tell ya this.
不能，但是我可以告诉你的是。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
When I accepted my lord's blood into my veins... I felt as though I was reborn. 
那位大人的血进入我身体的瞬间……我如同重获新生。

I see. A Bloodfiend's Kindred is like a sub-entity of the Bloodfiend, similar in concept to sub-entities created by Distortions or Abnormalities.
眷属……类似于扭曲和异想体创造出的下位个体。

It must have been desperation that pushed you to accept that proposition despite the lack of information.
未掌握准确情报便贸然接受，是因为当时已经走投无路了吧。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Maybe. That's... probably what was going through my head before I became a Kindred.
也许，我在变成眷属前……大概就是那样想的吧。

Thou hast been in cohorts with this villain... all this time? As his lackey?
汝……是那位血魔的手下吗？

Even ere then, when we first laid our eyes upon thee...?
与吾等初次相遇时便是了吗……？

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Lady, you have no idea how much I freaked out when one of you asked me something about "red eyes." Not that it would've mattered if you did suspect me though, since mine are just prosthetic.
被你问起红色眼睛的时候，我可是怕得要死啊。即使被怀疑的仅仅是单纯红色的义眼。

T-then... the passengers who were under thy protection...
那、那……受汝保护的那些乘客们……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Haven't I told you... that the count matters?
我说过吧。数量……数量很重要。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
The longer the procession... the better.
队伍……自然是越长越好。

dataList.title:
Bloodbag
血袋
dataList.content:
Ksshhh...
叽咿咿……

Dozens of Bloodbags began shambling into the room from behind Sasha.
... A smaller one among them stood out to me.
从萨莎背后出现的十几个血袋逼近了我们。……而在那之中，有一个非常矮的血袋。

... My mind immediately snapped to the child who grabbed Don Quixote's coattails.
突然，我脑海中闪过了那个向堂吉诃德伸出手的孩子。

I knew that the passengers were dead the moment we realized Sasha was a Bloodfiend. But... I hoped that we'd be spared this sight.
虽然知道萨莎是血魔的时候，我就已经意识到乘客们不可能安然无恙了……但是我也不想以这种方式和他们相见。

There was... a child...
那孩子也在……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Yep. Little runt wanted to be a Fixer if she got to grow up.
我知道，她说过长大之后想当收尾人吧。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Good thing she won't, though. I can tell you on good authority that "living" as a Bloodbag is way better than the drudgery that is the life of a Fixer. Believe me, I know.
不过比起当收尾人，当血袋能活得更轻松呢。作为收尾人活到现在的我可以保证。

... Hold thy vile tongue.
……闭上汝的嘴。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Dreaming of becoming a famous, respected Fixer? An enactor of justice? It's all just a stupid pipe dream that always ends in crushing disappointment. Or a really, really early grave.
梦想着成为一位满怀正义的著名收尾人的话，最后一定会失望的。要么就是早早死掉。

Silence... SILENCE!
吾已言明要汝闭嘴！

Don Quixote did not give Sasha time to finish her sentence; she was already charging full-speed at her with her lance drawn.
在萨莎说完前，堂吉诃德就已经拿起长枪冲了过去。
